sources.title: Morphological Features
sources.supports: Roots, lemmas, segmentation, morphosyntactic features; particles may have no root.
sources.boundary: Not a full semantic representation or universal ancestry proof.

sources.title: Quran Dictionary: nZr
sources.supports: Contextual and derivational variation among looking, waiting and respite.
sources.boundary: Brief glosses do not replace tafsir or semantic adjudication.

sources.title: Quran Dictionary: ktb
sources.supports: Writing, prescription and related senses occur within a root family.
sources.boundary: Shared root does not make propositions equivalent.

sources.title: QAC version 0.4 release notes
sources.supports: This release reports syntactic coverage of 30895/77429 words (40%).
sources.boundary: Do not equate morphology with full semantic or dependency coverage.

sources.title: Glottolog Arabic
sources.boundary: Does not support all-language descent from Quranic Arabic.

sources.title: Glottolog Semitic
sources.supports: Semitic family record and classification references.
sources.boundary: Catalog is a synthesis; detailed historical reconstruction was not re-performed here.

sources.title: Glottolog Indo-European
sources.supports: Separate Indo-European family-membership evidence and references.
sources.boundary: Semantic translation equivalence does not establish historical genealogy.

sources.title: UD for Turkish
sources.supports: Rich derivational/inflectional morphology and combined modality annotation.
sources.boundary: A common graph still needs language-specific analysis.

sources.title: UD for Chinese
sources.supports: No ordinary whitespace segmentation; particles, aspect markers and isolating morphology.
sources.boundary: Arabic morphology cannot simply be imposed on Chinese.

sources.title: Abstract Meaning Representation for Sembanking
sources.supports: Predicate relations, scoped negation/modalities, coreference, nominalization.
sources.boundary: Sentence-level original AMR is not complete discourse semantics.

sources.title: Universal Conceptual Cognitive Annotation
sources.supports: Conceptual graph units, semantic relations, abstraction over surface constructions.
sources.boundary: Graph semantics is established prior art, not this project's invention.

sources.title: Assessing the Cross-linguistic Utility of Abstract Meaning Representation
sources.supports: Source language, annotation and translation affect parallel semantic graphs.
sources.boundary: Do not assume perfect language-invariant representation.

sources.title: Efficient Semiring-Weighted Earley Parsing
sources.access: Primary abstract and complexity conditions inspected
sources.supports: Weighted grammar inference without transformer attention.
sources.boundary: Its bounds do not automatically apply to unrestricted graph unification or reasoning.
